label: the blob
note: IP-neutral. Issue #220: a big purple blob that rolls about the home planet's desert. Touch it (on foot, or ride a speeder into it) and you die on the spot, then wake as from any other death. It wanders with no pull toward or away from the town: its heading drifts at random, and only a loose leash round its home spot (out in the desert, not the town) turns it back if it strays too far. Now and then it farts. Read by src/systems/world/desert_blob.gd.

lines.killed: The blob rolled right over you.
lines.woke: You wake up in the pit, smelling faintly of blob.
